diagnosed: Two real, recurring workflow failures — both rooted in .github/workflows/** (a protected automation path). (1) Research agent: every bot-dispatched escalation fails with 'Action failed with error: Workflow initiated by non-human actor: github-actions (type: Bot). Add bot to allowed_bots list or use \'*\' to allow all bots.' Scout/coverage-critic escalate research via `gh workflow run` using GITHUB_TOKEN, so the dispatched actor is github-actions[bot], which claude-code-action@v1 now rejects because allowed_bots is empty. The entire deep-tier escalation path is dead (confirmed on runs 40867673370, 40093716136→? , 40302197172 workflow_dispatch, 40116792792, 39978404914 — all 'non-human actor'). Scheduled cron research runs are unaffected. (2) Visual QA agent: fails nearly daily with 'Execution failed: Reached maximum number of turns (40)' (run 40515757193, num_turns 41) — the --max-turns 40 budget in visual-qa-agent.yml is at the margin for screenshot-at-3-widths + look + write + commit(+rebase); the log commits most days but the action still exits 1 and on some days (e.g. Oct 27) the log is not committed at all.
notes: Could not author either fix: both live in .github/workflows/** and protect-automation.js (PreToolUse hook, CI-only) BLOCKS unattended CI agents from editing protected automation paths — 'A human must author changes to these files.' Confirmed by an actual blocked Edit this run. These paths also never auto-merge (merge-gate.js). OWNER ACTION REQUIRED. (The improve agent already noted both as 'owner-only, blocked for CI agents by protect-automation.js'.)

Ruled out as cause: tests (npm test — 1546 pass), validation (validate-events.js — 0 errors), publish freshness (publish-freshness.json status 'fresh', lag 0h), and quota (usage-state.json green: session 1% / week 9%, skipAll=false). So these are not quota/transient noise.

OWNER FIX 1 (.github/workflows/research-agent.yml): add `allowed_bots: github-actions` under `with:` to all THREE `anthropics/claude-code-action@v1` steps (standard Opus, deep Fable, deep Opus fallback). The only bot that dispatches this workflow is github-actions, so allowlist exactly that one rather than '*'. This revives the scout/coverage-critic -> research deep-tier escalation path.

OWNER FIX 2 (.github/workflows/visual-qa-agent.yml): raise `--max-turns 40` to `--max-turns 60` in the single claude-code-action step. timeout-minutes is 15 and the action runs ~4 min, so turn budget (not wall-clock) is the binding constraint; 60 gives safe headroom without materially more cost (optional agent, once daily, usage-gated).
